rounds.name: Tavern Chat
rounds.intro: Answer an innocent question. Then a crewmate decides what you were REALLY asked.
questions: What’s your honest opinion of Mondays?
How do you feel about camping?
What do you think of pineapple on pizza?
How would you describe your own cooking?
What’s your opinion of karaoke?
How do you feel about surprise parties?
What do you think about going to the gym?
Describe your last holiday in a few words.
How do you feel about long car journeys?
What’s your opinion of group chats?
How do you feel about getting up early?
What do you think about cats?
How was your week, honestly?
What’s your opinion of reality TV?
How do you feel about dancing in public?
Describe the last film you watched.
What do you think of this party so far?
How do you feel about seagulls?
What’s your opinion of the British weather?
How do you feel about fancy dress?
rounds.twistPrompt: What were they REALLY asked? Write the question.
rounds.twistPlaceholder: e.g. How was the captain’s cooking?
rounds.setup: Down at the tavern, someone asked {name}:
fallbackTwists: What do you think of the captain’s singing?

What do you do when nobody’s watching?

What are you like before your first coffee?
How do you behave on a long flight?
rounds.twistPrompt: This is their confession. What crime are they wanted for?
